सुहित a. (f. ता) 1. Very fit or suitable; 2. salutary, beneficial; 3. very friendly, affectionate; 4. satiated.
सुहृद् (I) a. Having a kind heart, cordial, friendly, loving.
सुहृद् (II) m. 1. A friend, मंदायंते न खलु सुहृदामभ्युपेतार्थकृत्याः Megh.i.38; 2. an ally.
सुहृदय a. (f. या) 1. Good-hearted, sincere; 2. intimate, dear.
